note: Multilingual section-heading map for harvest-native.py. Built from the headings that ACTUALLY OCCUR in the 534 native-language articles this corpus links to (native-headings.py --write prints the evidence table), not from a general guess at Wikipedia. Every term below carries the number of quiet-half articles it was observed in; a term with n=0 is dead weight and should be deleted rather than kept 'just in case'.

method.candidates: level-2 headings tallied per wiki with four signals: n (articles), pos (median index among level-2s), chars (median stripped prose), list (median share of list lines). Plot sections are frequent, early (pos 0-1), prose-heavy and not lists; cast sections match on frequency and position but are lists; production/reception sections are prose but late.
method.decision: the blind rule generates candidates for recall; each candidate was then read in its own language and classified. The rule alone over-admits (it proposed produzione, hintergrund, produkcja, accoglienza as 'plot' purely because they sit at pos 1 and carry prose), so it is used as a net, not as the judge.
method.audit: harvest-native.py --stage headings re-runs the tally, reports terms never observed, and prints every article where NO plot heading matched together with its full heading list. That residual is the recall check: if a plot heading were missing from this map, it would appear there.

classes.plot: narrative synopsis of what happens in the film. Counts toward the 1,500-char evidence floor.
classes.overview: 'about the film' / 'outline' sections that mix a plot sketch with production and significance. Kept as text, labelled, and DELIBERATELY NOT counted as plot - see decisions.overview.
classes.criticism: critical reception / analysis prose. Harvested alongside, never counted toward the plot floor.

decisions.overview: ja 概要 (22 articles) and sv 'om filmen' (34) sit at pos 0 with prose and would raise plot coverage, but they are 'overview' sections that routinely open with production circumstances and box office. Admitting them would put exactly the fame-shaped material (reception, production, significance) that plot-source.js excluded in English into a field the scorer reads as plot. They are harvested into `overview` and the report states how many extra films they would have admitted.
decisions.de Hintergrund: background/production context, not plot, despite pos 1 and 859 median chars in 22 articles.
decisions.de Inhalt: genuine alternative to Handlung on de.wikipedia (11 articles, pos 0, 1279 chars) - admitted as plot.
decisions.fr Fiche technique: pos 1 and frequent (100 articles) but list=1.00 - the credits block. The list signal is what keeps it out.
decisions.it Produzione / pl Produkcja / zh 製作: production sections; the automatic rule proposed all three and all three are rejected.
decisions.ja ストーリー vs 概要: ストーリー (16) is a story synopsis and is admitted; 概要 is not.
decisions.compound headings: criticism is matched by stem substring because the headings compound in the wild ('accoglienza critica', 'kritik und auszeichnungen', 'sortie et accueil', 'recepción y críticas'). Plot is matched exact-or-prefix because plot headings do not compound in this corpus and substring matching on short stems ('trama') would drag in 'episodi e trame'.
